title: [FIFA] I just asked Fable and Ultrawork to create the best World Cup game
author: GlitteringJob9248
selftext:
To be fair I am really disappointed. Not 1 shotted, also the graphics are really bad… I think Claude may nerf fable today or maybe it cannot be used by ultrawork..

I fixed bug on this game for like a whole day now it is finally playable. Enjoy!

Golden Goal 2026 on Ai Game Share!
